news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
news.summary: Tenax reported cash and equivalents of $118.0 million as of June 30, 2026, boosted by $13.4 million in Q2 warrant exercise proceeds plus a further $8.1 million exercised after quarter-end, extending its runway through Q2 2028; Q2 net loss widened to $17.8 million from $10.9 million a year earlier as R&D spend rose on LEVEL and LEVEL-2 trial activity. The company reaffirmed that topline LEVEL data are expected in August 2026, with LEVEL-2 enrollment targeted for completion by the end of 2027.

news.headline: Chardan Capital Initiates a Buy Rating on Tenax Therapeutics (TENX)
news.source: The Globe and Mail / Chardan Capital Markets
news.summary: Chardan Capital analyst Gautam Chukka initiated coverage of TENX with a Buy rating and a $27 price target, citing the upcoming pivotal Phase 3 LEVEL readout for TNX-103 in PH-HFpEF.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity Initiates Coverage on Tenax Therapeutics with Buy Rating, $35 Price Target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage of Tenax with a Buy rating and a $35.00 price target, joining a wave of sell-side initiations ahead of the company's imminent Phase 3 LEVEL data readout.

news.headline: Evercore ISI Initiates Tenax Therapeutics Stock Coverage With Outperform Rating
news.summary: Evercore ISI initiated coverage with an Outperform rating and a $39 price target, assigning roughly a 50% probability of success to the Phase 3 LEVEL trial and outlining a risk/reward skewed toward large upside on positive data versus steep downside on failure.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Presentation of LEVEL Clinical Trial Data at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Tenax announced that full results from its registrational Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF will be presented in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology Congress 2026 in Munich, Germany, on August 29, 2026, by Professor Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University.

news.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Reiterates Tenax Therapeutics Overweight Rating, $35 Price Target
news.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Olivia Brayer Saunders reiterated an Overweight rating and maintained a $35.00 price target on Tenax ahead of the Phase 3 LEVEL data readout, citing the large unmet need in PH-HFpEF and the trial's favorable statistical power.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 LEVEL topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Tenax expects to report topline data from the registrational Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF, evaluating 6-minute walk distance in over 230 enrolled patients; the trial is powered at over 90% to detect a 25-meter treatment effect. Data had not yet been released as of early August 2026.

catalysts.label: Late-breaking LEVEL data presentation at ESC Congress 2026 (Munich)
catalysts.detail: Full LEVEL trial results will be presented in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology Congress (August 28-31, Munich) by Professor Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 pivotal trial enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: Tenax is enrolling its second global Phase 3 pivotal trial (LEVEL-2) of TNX-103 in PH-HFpEF, activating additional sites with enrollment completion targeted by year-end 2027.

catalysts.label: Potential regulatory submission planning for TNX-103
catalysts.detail: Pending positive LEVEL results, the company is expected to outline next steps toward an NDA filing for oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF; no formal FDA submission date has been confirmed.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and corporate update
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's quarterly reporting cadence, Tenax is expected to report third-quarter 2026 financial results and provide a further corporate update, likely including post-LEVEL-readout commentary.

pulse: Tenax Therapeutics is a clinical-stage cardiopulmonary company on the immediate verge of its first major Phase 3 readout: topline data from the registrational LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF are expected any day in August 2026, with a late-breaking full-data presentation scheduled for ESC Congress 2026 in Munich on August 29. A wave of sell-side initiations through June-July (Cantor Fitzgerald, Evercore ISI, Canaccord Genuity, Chardan Capital) pushed the consensus to a bullish tilt with price targets as high as $35-39, even as commentators flagged steep downside risk if the trial fails, reflecting the stock's highly binary risk/reward heading into the catalyst. The company ended Q2 2026 with $118.0 million in cash, further bolstered by post-quarter warrant exercises, giving a runway through Q2 2028 while it simultaneously ramps enrollment in the second pivotal LEVEL-2 trial.
